question:
Select the correctly spelt word to fill in the blank.

My mother said that every relationship must have some amount of _________.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"flexibility"** means the quality of bending easily without breaking; it can also refer to the ability to be easily modified. (लचीलापन)

 
 
• **Example:** Yoga helps in improving flexibility and strength.
 
 
 
• **"Flexibility"** means the quality of being adaptable or variable. (लचीलापन)
 
 
• **Example:** Flexibility in the workplace can lead to increased productivity and employee satisfaction.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Phlexibility**: This is an incorrect spelling and does not have a meaning.
 
• **Flexebility**: This is an incorrect spelling and does not have a meaning.
 
• **Flaxiblety**: This is an incorrect spelling and does not have a meaning.
